segments.dry: Several dry-skin reviewers report the cleanser removes dead skin and leaves fewer dry patches without stripping or over-drying, one noting an end to dry flaky skin.
segments.sensitive: Sensitive-skin reviewers mostly describe it as gentle and non-irritating with no breakouts, though one reports a rosacea flare with daily use that resolved when cutting back to once or twice a week.
segments.mature: A reviewer in her 70s and another around 45 describe it as a gentle daily exfoliant that helps with dullness, fine lines and skin turnover.

concerns.aging: Reviewers using it alongside retinol or glycolic routines credit it with helping cell turnover and reducing dullness and fine lines; effects are described as gradual over weeks.
concerns.dehydration: Most reviewers say it cleans without stripping or drying the skin, and one with very dry skin reports no dryness; one review specifically states it ended dry flaky skin.
concerns.redness: One rosacea-prone user reports a flare after several consecutive days of use, resolved by reducing frequency to once or twice weekly; other sensitive-skin users report no irritation at all.
concerns.barrier: Multiple reviewers emphasize the cleanser does not feel stripping despite exfoliating, describing skin as clean but not tight or dry afterward.
concerns.spots: One reviewer credits it with reaching into congested areas ('getting at bumps'), but this is not echoed by other reviews.
concerns.blemishes: One reviewer with acne-prone, sensitive, very dry skin reports improvement and compliments after a week of use; no other reviewer specifically addresses acne.
concerns.oiliness: No reviews address oily or excess-oil concerns.

extraits.texte: I was using lancer for years and was still feeling I looked a little dull so gave this a try…I mean GP has amazing skin so why not. I love it so much. I try to only use it 1x a day since exfoliates. After a week I saw improvements and was getting compliments. I'm a basic sunscreen with tint, blush and mascara gal and I truly love how my face looks at this time. I've been using it now for 3 months and this is on my subscription. I enjoy the smell and the feel, have no prob with either. I am 45 (46 in one month), sensitive, acne prone, very dry skin.

It smells so fresh and is just exactly the right consistency to lightly exfoliate my face, neck chest and forearms. It leaves me feeling super clean and refreshed. I'm 71 and have given this product to my 3 grown daughters and my sister in law more than once. It's a real skin care staple for me.

extraits.titre: Mild everyday exfoliation for an everyday glow.
extraits.texte: Use this mild exfoliation every day. I learned from GP that the exfoliation is the key for the glowing skin. It is mild on my sensitive skin suitable for every day usage, love the texture and the smell.
Gentle but effective. When used a few days in a row it did cause a rosacea flare which was easily fixed by reducing to once or twice a week.
Love this stuff. It's a really good cleanser and gentle for everyday use. No more dry flaky skin.

I love Goop products, but this is not my favorite. The scent is similar to cilantro. The texture may be exfoliating to the skin, but when rinsed off, it feels like a film is left on your skin. I need to wash my face again to remove that.
I have buy another one; I go through it so quickly, 2x/day. A very deep cleanse, getting at bumps and fine lines, with such a lovely feel and fragrance without drying.
